messages.welcome: Hi. I can help you explore Jesus projects, experience and technical profile. What would you like to check?
messages.projects: Jesus's portfolio includes Aprende con Jesús Dev, FocusFlow, ConnectingDevs and GIBORA. It spans a public learning platform and frontend and Full Stack projects at different stages.
messages.stack: His main stack is centered on Angular, TypeScript, Laravel, PHP, MySQL and PostgreSQL. He also works with testing, Docker, GitHub Actions and AI-assisted tools used with technical review.
messages.experience: Jesus has technical experience at Pegasus Medical, where he worked with Laravel, Filament, MySQL, RFID, reporting, Docker and Linux. Before that, he built experience in team management and operations as a Center Director.
messages.availability: He is open to Frontend and Full Stack opportunities, especially in Angular and Laravel environments, as well as technical collaborations.
messages.services: He is also open to building landing pages, corporate websites, digital menus and web solutions for small businesses, always defining the real project scope first.
messages.contact: You can contact Jesus from the contact page, LinkedIn, GitHub or email.

about.title: I build software with discipline, consistency and a focus on useful solutions.
about.intro: I am Jesus Martinez Escobar, a Full Stack Developer focused on Angular and Laravel. I moved into development after working in sport and team management, where I learned to stay organized, communicate clearly and work toward results.
paragraphs: My background in physical conditioning and my experience in sports centers, including team coordination and customer service, still shape how I work: listen first, prioritize well and move forward with method.

Karate, judo, football and physical training gave me a practical relationship with discipline and continuous improvement. I bring that mindset into development by breaking problems down, working in phases and building clear, maintainable software.

aprendeConJesusDev.shortDescription: Public learning platform with complete JavaScript, TypeScript and Python paths.
aprendeConJesusDev.summary: Public learning platform covering 3 languages and 9 levels through 210 lessons, 114 exercises and 450 questions, with isolated in-browser practice.
aprendeConJesusDev.problem: Bring JavaScript, TypeScript and Python fundamentals into coherent, verifiable and accessible learning paths without relying on accounts, saved progress or server-side code execution.
aprendeConJesusDev.solution: I built a mobile-first catalog grounded in official sources, combining theory, exercises, quizzes and isolated runners for practicing each language directly in the browser.
decisions: Original content linked to official documentation and organized through stable identifiers
No users, forms, saved progress or product backend
Runtimes loaded on demand with explicit limits around learner code execution
architecture: Next.js App Router with React and typed curriculum data
Opaque sandbox and disposable Workers for JavaScript and TypeScript
Dedicated Pyodide Worker for Python without sending learner code to a server
quality: Node tests and 100% coverage scoped to four explicit core logic and protocol modules
Playwright Chromium E2E on desktop and mobile, including a 320 px overflow check
Build, lint, HTTP smoke and browser smoke automated in GitHub Actions
aprendeConJesusDev.deployment: GitHub Actions runs the quality gates and, after a valid push to main, deploys to Vercel and verifies the stable domain with HTTP smoke and Playwright.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy explains how jesusdev.dev handles data in a static personal portfolio context.

overview.title: Overview
items: jesusdev.dev is a personal developer portfolio hosted as a static website on GitHub Pages.
The site has no user accounts, registration, ecommerce, payments, backend database or server-side form storage.

data.title: Data handled by this site
items: The site itself only stores functional browser preferences for language and theme.
If you use a contact link, your email application opens a mailto message. The site does not submit, store or process that message through a backend.

storage.title: LocalStorage preferences
items: Language preference is stored in localStorage under jesusdev-language.
Theme preference is stored in localStorage under theme.

hosting.title: Hosting
items: The site is served by GitHub Pages, a GitHub static site hosting service for HTML, CSS and JavaScript files.
GitHub may process standard technical request data, such as IP address, device/browser information, request date and service logs, as part of providing the hosting service.

cookies.title: Cookies and tracking
items: This site does not set tracking cookies and does not use visitor measurement scripts, advertising pixels or similar tracking tools.
The preferences described above use browser localStorage, not third-party tracking cookies.

contact.title: Contact
items: For privacy questions, use the contact action on this page. It opens your email client through a mailto link.

cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.intro: This cookie policy explains the browser storage used by jesusdev.dev and clarifies that the site does not use tracking cookies.

overview.title: Overview
items: The site is static and does not use cookies for visitor measurement, advertising, accounts, ecommerce or payments.
The only browser-side data intentionally stored by the site is localStorage preferences.

localStorage.title: LocalStorage used
items: jesusdev-language stores the selected language: es, en or fr.
theme stores the selected theme: dark or light.

notUsed.title: What is not used
items: No visitor measurement scripts, advertising cookies or tracking pixels are loaded by this site.
No preference data is sent to a backend database by this site.

manage.title: Managing local preferences
items: You can change language and theme from the header at any time.
You can also clear both preferences from your browser settings by deleting site data for jesusdev.dev.

contact.title: Contact
items: For questions about browser storage, use the contact action on this page.
